explanation: The theorem is proved by `rfl`. It only unfolds the library's own definition of `reducedSingularHomologyTwoSphereTwoIntegerIso` into a composite of three other isomorphisms that the library also defines: `sphere2ReducedMayerVietorisIso`, the homotopy-equivalence iso and `reducedSingularHomologyOneSphereOneIntegerIso`. Since all of its content lies in the library's own definitions, no Mathlib declaration can carry it. Mathlib also has no computation of the reduced singular homology of spheres that this could be a duplicate of. I did not search Mathlib, because a statement of this kind cannot have a Mathlib counterpart.
